questions.explainKo: 정답: ③ Not really. It's difficult for me. ((답지 P147R Dialog 실전 문제 pp.22-23 01)
questions.promptEn:
다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: Are you good at math?
B: ______
choices: Yes, I hate studying math.
No, it's my favorite subject.
Not really. It's difficult for me.
Yes, I'm doing my math homework.
No, I'm not. I enjoy solving math problems.

questions.promptEn:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것을 모두 고르면?
A: Will Jenny come to the party?
B: ______ She's really excited about it.
choices: She never enjoys parties.
I don't think she will come.
I'm sure that she won't miss it.
She said she doesn't want to go.
I believe she will come to the party.

questions.promptEn:
다음 대화의 ⓐ~ⓓ를 순서대로 바르게 배열한 것은?
ⓐ Thanks. You can try some if you want.
ⓑ Rosa, are you good at baking?
ⓒ That's amazing. Your bread must be delicious.
ⓓ Yes. I started learning to bake three years ago.

questions.explainKo: 정답: "I'm sure you'll like it.". ((답지 P147R Dialog 실전 문제 pp.22-23 04)
questions.promptEn:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 우리말에 맞도록 괄호 안의 단어들을 이용하여 다섯 단어로 영작하시오.
A: This pasta looks tasty. Did you make it?
B: Yes, I did. Go ahead and try it. (내가 곧 층 이할 거라고 확신해. = sure, like)
accept: I'm sure you will like it.

questions.promptEn:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 흐름상 어색한 것은?
A: I want to ①take the soccer class.
B: Okay. Are you ②good at playing soccer?
A: ③Yes, I am.
B: That's okay. ④I'm sure you will learn a lot ⑤from the class.
choices: ① take
② good at
③ Yes, I am.
④ I'm sure you will
⑤ from

questions.explainKo: 정답: ① I think you're already good.. ((답지 P147R Dialog 실전 문제 pp.22-23 06)
questions.promptEn:
[06-09] 다음 대화를 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
G: Jiwon, I saw your dance video on social media.
B: Really? What did you think of it?
G: It was amazing. You are really good at dancing!
B: Thank you. I often make dance videos and post them.
G: That's great. Look, this video got a lot of comments. People said that they loved your dance moves.
B: I'm glad to hear that. But I should practice more.
G: ⓐ ______
B: Actually, I'm practicing new dance moves these days. They are very difficult.
G: I see. I'm sure you will learn them quickly!

06 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: I think you're already good.
You can't be a good dancer.
I'm not sure if you can dance well.
You shouldn't change your dance moves.
I don't think your dance moves are very good.

questions.promptEn:
[10~13] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
B: Hi, nice to meet you. I'm Jake, the new guitarist.
G: Nice to meet you. Welcome to our band! I'm Luna, and I play the drums.
B: Oh, I heard that you are good at ⓐ______ the drums.
G: That's nice ⓑ______. I practice a lot.
B: Well, ⓒI look forward to playing with you.
G: Yes, it will be fun! I'm sure we will make a great band.

to play / hearing
playing / heard
playing / to hear
be playd / to hear
